# Pim van den Berg – Perspectives

> Pim van den Berg defines the visual DNA of brands, cities and organisations. His approach, "streetology", is about really seeing: observations, visual storytelling and discovery tours around the world for retail, food, real estate, financial services and municipalities.

## Pages

- [Home, Dutch](/): Welcome, columns, videos, travels, manifesto, assignments, about and contact details — all on one page.
- [Home, English](/en/): The same page in English.
- [Travel map](/travels/): More than 33,000 of Pim's photos on a world map, by date and trip.

- [Manifesto (PDF, English)](/WEBSITE_01_MANIFESTO.pdf): Pim van den Berg's 25-point manifesto on the future of streetology.
- [Manifest (PDF, Dutch)](/Manifest-Pim-van-den-Berg.pdf): The same manifesto in Dutch.
